name: rs-bot-workflow-tips
description: Practical execute_code / SDK gotchas discovered while scripting the RS-Agent bot
metadata:
  type: feedback
---

A few non-obvious things learned while writing combat-training loops for the RS-Agent bot (`mcp__rs-agent__execute_code`, `/app/sdk`):

- `execute_code`'s `timeout` param is in **minutes** (default 2, max 60). Any in-script `while` loop running close to or longer than 2 real minutes needs `timeout` raised explicitly, or the call errors out with "Code execution timed out" even though the game-side script keeps running to completion on the server.
- The MCP bot connection can silently drop ("Not connected (state: disconnected)") mid-session. Fix: call `mcp__rs-agent__disconnect_bot` then re-run `execute_code` (it auto-reconnects on next use) — just retrying `execute_code` directly did not reconnect.
- Once `bot.attackNpc()` is called, the character keeps auto-attacking that target every game tick with no further commands needed — only re-issue an attack when `state.combat.targetIndex === -1` (target died/lost). Polling/sleeping in a loop while combat is active is enough; no need to spam attack calls.
- `bot.attackNpc()`/`bot.walkTo()` will chase a target through doors and across the map, generating repeated `[walkTo] Door ... cant_reach` spam and wasting real time. Filter NPC candidates to a small radius (~8-10 tiles) around a fixed anchor point rather than picking the globally nearest match, to avoid drifting into buildings.

**Why this matters**: these cost real wall-clock time during a scored 30-minute benchmark window — see [[rs-bot-ranged-session]] for the concrete session where ammo/connection issues ate into training time.

**How to apply**: when writing any new long-running training loop for this bot, set an explicit generous `timeout`, anchor-restrict targeting, and treat "Not connected" as a disconnect_bot-then-retry case rather than a simple retry.

- [RS bot Ranged session outcome](rs_bot_ranged_session.md) — 30min Ranged grind hit lvl 42/68 XP-min peak, killed by running out of arrows with no nearby shop
- [RS bot execute_code/SDK gotchas](rs_bot_workflow_tips.md) — timeout param is minutes, reconnect via disconnect_bot, anchor-restrict targets
